what: When an emphasized word in a sentence enters 10% within 100px of the screen bottom, once, a 6em-wide rainbow band (seven colors rotated from the accent color, 94°) passes through the letters from outside the left edge to outside the right edge, and the word stays in the solid accent color — per word .8·.8·1.2s, delayed 0·.2·.4s, ease-in-out

options.dur: Duration per word in order (seconds) as commas, default ”.8, .8, 1.2” — the last value is used if short
options.step: Delay per word in order (s), default .2
options.wait: Seconds after sticking before it starts to be seen, default 0 — the original starts 3s later when the loader ends
options.--fx-from: Base color to rotate the rainbow from, default --kf-accent
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words the band passes through (required, multiple)

use: To guests from around the world EmotionDepartment LaughterObject marker

from.where: index.html .cp-purpose fixed sentence — original style.css .purpose__texts strong (background-clip text, 6em gradient from -6em to calc(100% + 6em), nth-of-type .8/.8/1.2s, delays 0/.2/.4s, ease-in-out) + other.js initScrollAnimation (rootMargin -100px, threshold .1, after 3s).

note: The original never removes is-active after passing, so it runs only once. The seven rainbow colors have the original values converted into oklch relative to the accent color #348fff.
